senses.gloss: m.Koy, (prob.) a kind of bearded dear or antelope (τραγέλαφος). [The rabbis leave it undecided whether K. belongs to the genus of cattle (בְּהֵמָה) or beasts of chase (חַיָּה).] Y. Bicc. II, end, 65ᵇ, v. עִיזָּה.
